title: Second Highest Salary
description:
Table `Employee` holds employee salaries.

Write a query to report the **second highest distinct** salary. If there is no second highest salary, report `NULL`.

Name the output column `SecondHighestSalary`. The result must be exactly one row.
hint: LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1 over DISTINCT salaries gets the value — but wrapping it in an outer SELECT is what guarantees one row (NULL) when it doesn't exist.
outputExplanation: The distinct salaries are 100, 200 and 300. After the highest (300), the second highest is 200.

tests.name: Ties at the top — without DISTINCT, OFFSET 1 returns 300 instead of 200
Exactly two employees with equal salaries
Duplicate top salary — LIMIT OFFSET without DISTINCT returns 200 instead of 100
Exactly two employees with distinct salaries
Mixed positive, negative, zero and duplicates
Stress test with 30 rows and many duplicates
One non-NULL salary and NULLs — no second distinct value exists
